patthana8.2:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. vicikicchā sahagataṃ uddhacca sahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtādve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā. mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. vicikicchā sahagataṃ uddhacca sahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā-. paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca sahetukā khandhā-. na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko ca na ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.2:2.1: na ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.2:3.1: na sahetukañca na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sahetukañca na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sahetukañca na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko ca na ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.2:4.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe cha, avigate nava,
patthana8.2:6.1: na sahetuko dhammo na sahetukassa dhamma hetupaccayena paccayo. na sahetuko dhammo na ahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. na sahetuko dhammo na sahetukassa ca na ahetukassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana8.2:7.1: na ahetuko dhammo na ahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, tīṇi.

patthana8.2:9.1: hetuyā cha, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava.
